findings.sourceReading: Rosa notices that the tenth twilight uniquely has 黄金の郷 instead of 黄金郷. She corrects her reading from キョウ to サト; narration explicitly calls attention to the inserted の. Her Kyoto theory comes from having mistakenly read the 郷 as キョウ.
findings.alternative: An English adaptation can explain the Japanese writing, and commented draft lines here demonstrate that option, but active WH instead claims the text calls the location a capital. 郷 is not 京. The added Tokyo/Kyoto 京 explanation changes the clue rather than exposing the source’s spelling distinction.
